cues.en: All right.
In the last lecture we have created an array in JavaScript.
Now in this lecture we are going to look at inserting elements to the array in JavaScript.
Inserting elements into an array can be achieved through several methods.
Let's consider the most common ones and their respective time and space complexities.
Now the first way is by using push function.
Push function is used to add one or more elements to the end of the array, and it returns the new length
of the array.
So here we have created an array like this.
So what I'm going to do I'm just going to go ahead and use RR dot push and add a new element.
Now after adding this we can go ahead and run our code.
You will see that when we are printing out the array to the console, it is printing out with five elements.
So five over here is inserted at the end of the this array.
Now if I just go ahead and run this push function one more time for example for six and print out the
result to the console.
You will see that in this case, it's just going to print out the six elements array to the console
like this.
So the last element over here is six because we have used the push function to insert the element.
Now the time complexity for push function is going to be amortized over assuming that the capacity is
available and the space complexity is also O one because only one element is inserted.
In this case, in most cases, push operation can be done in a constant time, but if underlying array
needs to be resized, this operation can take o n time, where n is the number of elements in the array.
Now, the next way of inserting elements to the array in JavaScript is Unshift function.
Unshift function is used to add one or more elements to the beginning of the array, and it returns
the length of the array.
So we can go ahead and delete this push, and instead of push one we can put over here unshift.
Then I'm just going to insert one more time five over here.

are shifted one step.

Splice function takes three arguments.
The first one is going to be the start index, and the second one is going to be the number of the elements
to remove, and the third one is going to be new element to be inserted.
